messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm assembling the short release entry for the next deploy. Need a focused pass on examples, SDK snippets, and the 'known issues' blurb. Draft is in the PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4892 :eyes:

alex: Looking. I'll fix the Python snippet that's still using old client v0 imports. Small change but it breaks the copy/paste flow.

sam: I can take link sweep. Found 2 dead links in the migration guide (internal infra links). Will post fixes as a separate PR and reference here.

maria: Thanks — priority order: 1) SDK snippet correctness, 2) example outputs (JSON shapes), 3) known-issues wording, 4) links.

alex: Pushed a tiny commit to PR 4892 to update the Python/TS snippets. Also added a one-line note about token units. Snippet before:
```python
from redwood import Client  # old
client = Client(api_key=... )
```
and after:
```python
from redwood_inference import RedwoodClient  # new
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}")
```

sam: Nice. For the migration guide links I removed two absolute internal urls and replaced with relative paths. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4896

jeremy: Heads up — can we also call out the Dedicated capacity change in the notes? People will expect the new autoscale defaults. Suggest one bullet under 'behavior changes' and link to the dedicated config doc.

maria: Yes. Draft sentence: "Dedicated autoscale default now prefers steady-minimum for bursty tail workloads — see Dedicated autoscale docs for tuning." Can someone make wording more concise?

alex: Suggest: "Dedicated: default autoscale policy favors steady baseline to improve tail latency; adjust min/max in dedicated-config.md."

maria: Good. Sam — when you submit the link PR, can you also add an anchor to dedicated-config.md so the release note links directly?

sam: Will do. Also flagged a small example output mismatch in the embeddings example — vector length labeled 1536 but actual model returns 1280. I can normalize the example to use a generic placeholder like `<embedding_length>`.

maria: Use placeholder approach. Avoid hard numbers unless tied to a model version. Add a parenthetical note: (embedding length varies by model).

jeremy: One more thing — 'known issues' draft contains customer-facing language that sounds too technical. Proposed rewrite: "We are investigating intermittent 503s for very large batch requests; workaround: reduce batch size or fall back to Dedicated pool." Shorter, clearer.

maria: Love it. Replace the current paragraph with your line, and add a link to the incident doc.

alex: After my fix, I ran the TS examples locally. I added small timeouts to prevent hanging in the browser snippet — see inline comment.

docs-bot: Reminder: docs PR 4892 has an outstanding review request from @maria. Please resolve merge conflicts before CI runs.

maria: Plan for next steps: Alex merge the snippet fixes into 4892, Sam merge link fixes 4896, Jeremy update known-issues and the autoscale bullet in 4892, then I will do a final sweep and land the release entry. Targeting deploy window tomorrow 15:00 PT.

sam: I'll tag the anchor change and link tests in 4896.

alex: Merging snippet commit now, will push small follow-up if CI complains.

maria: Great — thanks everyone. If anything blocks, @maria in #general. :raised_hands:
